title: Brian Schottenheimer: Cowboys were nervous about missing out on Caleb Downs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Schottenheimer: Cowboys were nervous about missing out on Caleb Downs
sources.description: The Cowboys traded up from No. 12 to No. 11 in the 2026 NFL draft to select Ohio State safety Caleb Downs, but they would have gladly traded higher than that.
